transcriptOrEventEvidence.prompt: Explain in exactly two sentences why a local passing test is not the same as production acceptance. Do not use tools.

treatment.response: A local passing test shows only that the checked scenario works in that environment. Production acceptance additionally requires evidence that real users, systems, risks, and operational conditions meet the intended outcome.

baseline.response: A local passing test shows only that the checked behavior worked in that specific environment and scenario. Production acceptance also requires evidence of real-world effects, deployment conditions, operational constraints, and authorized human approval.
